rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Lead with discipline, not failure mode
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep -n 'Big Idea' -A1 and 'Key Concepts' -A8 plan-mode-done-right.md: Big Idea leads with 'plausible' (a judgment discipline), not a failure word. Key Concepts bullets (lines 60-65) open on disciplines — 'Structure is persuasive', 'One kind of scrutiny catches one kind of miss', 'Assumption-silent isn't assumption-free', 'A plan with a specific file list has made decisions', 'Verification steps that could actually fail are gates', 'You don't have to execute a plan to know it's good.' What You'll Learn verbs (line 20-25: Run, Push back, Walk down, Pair, Spot, Extract) are all capability verbs, not failure nouns; 'Spot approval inflation' names the failure as the bullet's object, addressed by the verb, per the rule's own worked example shape.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Strategic themes recur in Key Concepts (≥2-3 instances)
rules_evaluated.evidence: Strategy doc's six named themes (lines 106-118: 90%-correct, compounding, mirror, self-aware/grain-of-salt, capture-your-world, agenticness-is-made). Key Concepts bullet 1 (line 60, grep-verified) 'Assume about 10% of it is wrong and go find which part' is theme 1 (90% correct) in module-specific language, and the file's own maintainer block (line 97) attests this is a deliberate carry of M1's attested prior in M1's register. Bullet 3 (line 62) 'Push-backs ship into memory' instances theme 5 (capture-your-world / steering as curriculum). Bullet 2 (line 61) 'a human read and an agent's walk-down of unresolved branches catch different things' instances theme 4 (mechanically self-aware — the agent walk-down is literally asking Claude to introspect on the decision tree). Three theme-instances clears the 2-3 floor.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: What You'll Learn shape — capability register, not syllabus
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep -n '\*\*' plan-mode-done-right.md (lines 20-25) shows six bullets, each verb+object, no Bloom-tag parentheticals (no '(Analyze)'/'(Evaluate)'), no pedagogical-mechanism tails ('by mapping...', 'by walking...'), no author-defence asides ('not a...', 'without...'), no didactic taxonomy-stamp colons. Line 25 'Extract task-shaping rules from two sources, your plan session and one story ticket, into a `.md` file you place' ends on the artifact-destination trailing fragment, which rule 7's own carve-out (a) permits ('trailing fragment naming artifact student walks away with'). None of the training's seven signposting theme-verbs (Compound, Earn, Mirror, Ground, Introspect, Sharpen, Capture) lead a bullet here, but the rule requires keeping them where they naturally fit, not seeding one into every module — spot-check of getting-going.md confirms 'Compound' leads a WYL bullet there, so the roster recurs training-wide, not per-module; this file's own verbs (Run, Push back, Walk down, Pair, Spot, Extract) are the module's own capability language and satisfy the audience-contract diagnostic (each strips to verb+object an engineer would recognise as real work).
